name: London Broil Chops
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a plastic bag. Marinade for 3-4 hours on counter or overnight in fridge.
Remove meat from marinade. Discard marinade.
BBQ, use medium to high heat and grill about 3 minutes per side. 6-7 minutes total. OR. Bake, set oven to 425˚F and bake for 12-15 minutes or until meat registers 145˚F.
Serve with rice or potatoes. The marinade has a big flavour so subtle side dishes are best.
